title: MedJev: Evaluating Zero-Shot System-One Decision Making in Medicine
abstract: arXiv:2610.36006v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: System One decision models such as Jev answer structured questions in a single forward pass without generating text, offering fast and computationally efficient clinical decision support. We evaluate MedJev, an open System One model that runs locally on a laptop, across ten medical benchmarks spanning medical knowledge, diagnosis, and patient level prediction using MIMIC IV and MIMIC IV ED. We compare MedJev against zero shot LLM baselines, published GPT results, and supervised models. MedJev achieves accuracies of 72.5 percent on MedQA, 75.4 percent on USMLE, and 80.1 percent on NEJM, approaching published GPT 4 performance while maintaining well calibrated confidence estimates (ECE 0.028 to 0.063). On patient level tasks, MedJev achieves an AUROC of 0.926 for In Hospital Mortality, exceeding XGBoost (0.902), but underperforms supervised models on operational outcomes such as ED Triage Admission (0.745 vs. 0.809). translated_title: MedJev：评估医学领域中的零样本“系统一”决策
translated_abstract: 系统一决策模型通过单次前向传播即可回答结构化问题而无需生成文本，为临床决策支持提供了快速且计算高效的方案。我们在涵盖医学知识、诊断以及基于MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-IV ED数据集的患者层面预测的十个医学基准上，评估了MedJev——一个可在笔记本电脑上本地运行的开源系统一模型。我们将MedJev与零样本LLM基线、已发表的GPT结果以及监督模型进行比较。MedJev在MedQA上达到72.5%的准确率，在USMLE上达到75.4%，在NEJM上达到80.1%，接近已发表的GPT-4性能，同时保持了良好的置信度校准（ECE为0.028至0.063）。在患者层面任务上，MedJev在院内死亡率预测中达到0.926的AUROC，超过了XGBoost（0.902），但在急诊科分诊入院等操作性结局上表现不及监督模型（0.745 vs. 0.809）。
tldr: MedJev是一个可在笔记本电脑上本地运行的开源“系统一”医学决策模型，在多项医学知识和诊断基准上接近GPT-4的性能，同时保持良好的置信度校准，为快速高效的临床决策支持提供了新方案。
en_tdlr: MedJev, an open System One model that runs locally on a laptop, approaches GPT-4 performance across medical knowledge and diagnosis benchmarks while maintaining well-calibrated confidence, enabling fast and computationally efficient clinical decision support.
